notes: Profile: mid-market product company building an agentic customer success assistant embedded in their SaaS product
Primary workload: multi-step agent flows that do search (internal docs + vector DB) then take actions (create tickets, call webhooks). Sensitivity around tool-call reliability and timeouts.
Latency SLOs: aiming for first-token/start-of-stream p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for streaming responses; end-to-end agent step (search + act) p95 target < 800ms when possible.
Cost sensitivity: will start on Hosted API for speed to market but expect to evaluate Dedicated if steady-state ARR > $75k/yr due to predictable throughput needs.
Model preferences: prefer Redwood-curated open models for cost control; open to fallback chain to smaller quantized models under load.
Streaming + function-calling: want robust streaming for progressive UI updates and deterministic function/tool-call acknowledgements (idempotency, retries).

POC success criteria proposed: 1) tool-call success rate >= 99% under synthetic load; 2) external tool-call timeout handling path exercised and verified; 3) streaming token latency meets p95 target in 80% of scenarios; 4) clear cost projection for Dedicated
Quote from Head of Platform: 'We need the assistant to feel instant — users drop off if agents are slow. Also need confidence that if a webhook fails, the agent won't hang our pipeline.'
Risk: reliance on third-party tool endpoints (customer's internal webhooks) - wants built-in retry/fallback patterns and observability at token + tool-call level
Security asks: SSO/SAML integration, audit logs per request, KMS integration for customer keys, residency controls for EU and NA customers
poc_plan: Week 0 - Scope and baseline: collect QPS, common prompt lengths, typical KV cache hit rates
Week 1 - Hosted API POC: run replayed agent flows at target QPS (simulated 10k MAU), measure streaming latencies, tool-call success and timeout behaviour
Week 2 - Failure modes: induced webhook failures, test retry/fallback policies, validate logs and traceability in Redwood Console
Deliverables: perf baseline report, cost model for steady state, recommended Dedicated config (GPU profile + autoscaling), security checklist completed
procurement_notes: Procurement timeline: legal + security review in parallel (2-3 weeks). Preferred contract: 12mo commit if Dedicated pricing attractive. Finance expects 30-day SLA negotiation.
